meta.promptText: Dark spots aur dull skin ke liye India mein konsa vitamin C serum kharidun?

response.text:
Dark spots aur dull skin ke liye **Minimalist 10% Advanced Vitamin C Serum** meri balanced recommendation hai—beginner-friendly, stable vitamin C formula, aur pigmentation/uneven tone ke liye suitable. Iske alternatives:

- **Sensitive skin:** Dr. Sheth’s Ceramide & 10% Vitamin C Ampoule—barrier-focused, relatively gentle option.[10]
- **Oily/acne-prone skin:** The Derma Co 10% Vitamin C + 5% Niacinamide—dark spots ke saath oiliness mein bhi helpful ho sakta hai.[2][9]
- **Stubborn spots, experienced users:** Plum 15% Vitamin C—15% strength hone ki wajah se pehle patch test karein.[8]
- **Budget option:** Garnier Vitamin C serum—Vitamin C ke saath niacinamide aur salicylic acid wala formula milta hai.[1]

**Kaise use karein:**  
Subah clean, dry face par 2–3 drops, phir moisturiser aur **SPF 50 sunscreen**. Sunscreen daily na lagane par dark spots wapas/darker ho sakte hain; vitamin C ko sunscreen ke saath use karna recommended hai.[8][10] Pehle haftे mein alternate days use karein, aur irritation ho to band kar dein. Results ko aam taur par 8–12 weeks dein. 

Agar dark patches melasma jaise hain, rapidly badh rahe hain, ya acne ke baad severe pigmentation hai, dermatologist se consult karna better rahega.
